column1: # Boot Bitch short button/action label glossary.
# Purpose: GUI button labels and other short action strings must stay SHORT
# action words, never machine-translated sentences.  Argos (and other MT
# backends) tends to render a one- or two-word button such as "Move Down" as a
# full imperative sentence, so these short labels are pinned here and applied
# last, winning over both tools/translate_overrides.tsv and the machine-
# translation backend for the exact source string.
#   - Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
#   - A cell may be empty to mean "no confident override for this language";
#     that string then falls through to machine translation.
#   - The source column matches the UNESCAPED <source> text exactly (e.g.
#   - This glossary is loaded after translate_overrides.tsv and wins for any
#     source present in both files, so a short label is pinned in exactly one
# Character-drift guard: tools/translate_ts.py also runs a post-translation
# pass that only REPORTS (it never edits) short labels whose translation is
# > 1.8x the source character length and which have no override in this
# glossary or in translate_overrides.tsv.  A "short label" is a source with no
